title: Welcome to SkyRPG
summary: What SkyRPG is, how to install the pack and join the server, and what is inside it.

s.x: SkyRPG is a Hypixel SkyBlock-style RPG for Minecraft Java Edition

, built on Fabric. You level skills, gather rare materials, craft better gear, fight bosses and clear dungeons, all the way up to the Ender Wyrm. Every gameplay system is our own mod. Other mods are only used for utilities.
This page tells you what you need to play, how to install it and join, and what the pack adds. Read

is the hub: a floating village above the clouds. Everyone spawns here. It is safe: nobody can fight, take damage or go hungry, and blocks cannot be broken or placed. The shops, the bank, the Masters of each skill and the Wildgate are here. See
is where you really play. Forests, caves, villages, dungeons, danger regions, the Nether and the End. Walk through the Wildgate or type
brings you home. You return to where you left off.
If you die without a bed you wake up in Skyhaven. Your coins are kept on death.
That is all. The SkyRPG instance brings Fabric Loader, Fabric API and every SkyRPG mod, and keeps them current.
The same SkyRPG version as the server. The instance updates itself, so you always match it.
Install Prism Launcher and sign in with your Minecraft account.
In Prism choose Add Instance, then Import, and pick the zip. An instance called SkyRPG appears.
Launch it. The first start downloads the mods, so it takes a moment. A small window shows the progress.
updates itself from GitHub every time you launch
. New and changed mods are downloaded, removed ones are deleted. You never need a new zip again. If you are offline, the game starts with the mods you already have.

blocks.text: Good to know before you start

s.x: Your settings and HUD layout are saved on your own computer, not on the server.
Your purse, bank, skills, pets, collections and quest progress are saved with your character on the server.
The server keeps a log of chat, so do not post anything private there.
The Nether and the End are the vanilla dimensions, with new biomes, dungeons and bosses added.
